key: Think of a driving school. Most school

alt: A driving learner moves through three stages: studying a cut-away engine, driving in city traffic, then tuning the engine himself.

LEFT panel: inside a small driving-school classroom with a whiteboard and plastic chairs, he leans over a table on which sits a cut-away model engine with its casing sliced open so pistons, gears and coloured pipes are visible; a middle-aged instructor in a white shirt points at the gears with a pen, and the learner looks absorbed. MIDDLE panel: the same learner now behind the wheel of a small white hatchback with an L sign on the bonnet, driving through a busy Indian street with autos, a bus, a cow at the roadside and a fruit cart; the instructor sits beside him, relaxed, thumbs up. key: Phone models change every few months, bu

alt: A row of phones from old to new, all sharing the same touchscreen, battery and SIM parts shown in a cut-away.
scene: A clean shop-counter scene seen from the customer's side: a long glass display case in a small Indian mobile shop, with a row of five smartphones laid out left to right, from a chunky older model with a thick bezel to a sleek new one with a curved edge, each on a small stand. Above the row, one large magnifying-glass bubble opens up the inside of a phone to show three simple parts glowing softly: a touchscreen layer, a rectangular battery and a tiny SIM card. Thin dotted lines run from that bubble down to every phone in the row, showing the same three parts sit inside all of them. Behind the counter a friendly shopkeeper in his 40s, in a striped half-sleeve shirt, holds up the newest phone while a college student in a hoodie on the near side nods calmly, as if to say he already understands it. On the back wall, posters of new phone launches are pinned over older faded posters, hinting that models keep changing. Warm tube-light glow, everyday and reassuring mood. Labels: "NEW EVERY YEAR" above the row of phones, "SAME CORE" beside the magnifying-glass bubble.

At the far right of the room stands a large clay tandoor, glowing orange inside, with a paper tag hanging from it reading "ON LOAN"; the smiling instructor, a woman in her 50s in a chef's coat, gestures towards it with an open palm, inviting the students to use it. Labels: "YOUR SKILLS" above the students' boards, "BORROWED GPU" on the floor beside the tandoor.

key: A three-tier cricket academy: Part 1 i

alt: A three-level cricket academy: a classroom on ball physics, net practice with a ready bat, and a craftsman shaping a personal bat.

FIRST floor: an indoor net with green netting, a teenage batter in pads and helmet facing a bowling machine, using a plain ready-made bat straight off a rack of identical bats on the wall. TOP floor: a small workshop with wood shavings on the floor, where an elderly bat-maker in a kurta and spectacles planes the blade of a willow bat, while the same teenage batter stands beside him gripping the handle to test its weight, a measuring tape around the handle. A staircase on the side links all three floors, with a small side door on the first floor showing a player walking in directly without passing the classroom. Afternoon sunlight through the windows, purposeful mood. Labels: "PART 1" beside the ground floor, "PART 2" beside the first floor, "PART 3" beside the top floor.

A thin dotted arrow runs from the chit to a coin purse labelled with her name, showing that whoever has the secret can spend from it. scene: A split-panel illustration with a thin vertical divider. RIGHT panel: a dusty bus stand with a parked state transport bus behind; a thin man on a plastic stool sells stacks of spiral-bound photocopies of the very same recipe book, every page copied, piled high on a bedsheet on the ground, with a hand-written price card; a passer-by hesitates. A large red cross floats above this panel. Between the two panels at the bottom, a small envelope icon with a question mark suggests asking the publisher when unsure. Warm evening light in the dhaba, harsh afternoon sun at the bus stand. Labels: "FAIR USE" above the left panel, "NOT OK" above the right panel.

A small question-mark cloud floats over his head. RIGHT panel: the same stall today, a bit brighter, the same man now in a neat shirt, a laminated QR code card hanging from a string on the glass jar of biscuits; a queue of very different customers (a college girl, a delivery rider in a helmet, an elderly man with a walking stick, a construction worker) each hold up a phone to scan it, and a cheerful ding symbol pops from one phone. Behind the right panel, the same QR card is also visible at a fruit cart and a cobbler's box across the road, showing it is everywhere. Morning light, upbeat mood. Labels: "WHAT IS THAT?" above the left panel, "EVERYONE USES IT" above the right panel.

key: it covers bullock carts and bullet train

alt: A long road showing vehicles from a bullock cart to a bullet train under one banner, with one lane reserved for vehicles that run on language.
scene: A wide panoramic landscape with a long road and a railway line running left to right, like a timeline of vehicles under one big arching banner. On the far left, a bullock cart driven by a farmer in a turban with two white bullocks plods along; next a bicycle, then an auto rickshaw, a red public bus, and on the far right a sleek pointed-nose bullet train speeding along an elevated track. Under the bullock cart, a small inset bubble shows a simple video-game character on a pixel screen walking left when a player walks right, linking the humble cart to that simple game behaviour. In the middle of the road, one lane is painted with a different colour and filled with vehicles whose cargo is letters, speech bubbles and newspaper bundles: a delivery van stacked with books, a scooter carrying a speech-bubble sign, a train carriage with alphabet blocks in its windows. Bystanders on the roadside include a curious schoolboy pointing. Bright midday sun, open skies, wide sense of scale. Labels: "AI" on the big arching banner, "LANGUAGE AI" painted on the special lane.

key: A kirana shopkeeper reading a scribble
name: ch01_shopkeeper_order_note
alt: A kirana shopkeeper reads a scribbled order note and can reply, sort the customer into a type, or stamp a tag.
scene: A cosy kirana shop interior seen from just behind the counter, shelves of rice sacks, oil tins and soap boxes in the background. In the centre, a shopkeeper in his 50s with reading glasses on his nose and a sleeveless sweater over a shirt holds up a crumpled scribbled order note to the light, frowning slightly as he reads it. Three thin arrows branch from the note to three outcomes laid out left to right on the counter. LEFT: a small reply chit he is writing with a ballpoint, a few short lines and a smiling doodle, showing a written answer. MIDDLE: three labelled cardboard trays marked with simple icons (a family, a restaurant, a hostel) with the note being dropped into the family tray, showing he files the customer by meaning. RIGHT: an ink stamp pad and a rubber stamp that has just printed a bold red tag on the note. A small inset bubble in the top corner shows a laptop screen where the same scribble is turned into rows of numbers, hinting that a computer must convert it first. Warm afternoon light, homely mood. Labels: "TEXT" under the reply chit, "EMBEDDING" under the trays, "CLASS" under the stamp.

key: Tipping a sabzi bag out on the counter a
name: ch01_sabzi_bag_of_words
alt: Vegetables tipped from a bag onto a counter and counted, while a thought bubble wonders whether they were for chutney or curry.
scene: A top-down close-up of a wooden kitchen counter in an Indian home. A green cloth shopping bag lies on its side at the left, freshly emptied, and its contents are spread out and grouped into neat little heaps: three red tomatoes, two onions and one bunch of coriander. Beside each heap a small paper tag shows a tally number (3, 2, 1) in chalk-like handwriting. The hands of a young woman in a printed cotton kurta are visible at the bottom of the frame, one hand counting on her fingers. At the top right, a large thought bubble rises from the scene and splits into two small pictures: a bowl of red tomato chutney with a question mark, and a pot of curry with another question mark, showing the counts cannot tell which dish was planned. Below the counter edge, a small inset bubble shows two short word cards, one reading "not good" and the other "good, not bad", both tipped into the same kind of tally heaps, with a puzzled face, hinting that order matters for words. Soft morning window light, calm domestic mood. Label: "BAG OF WORDS" printed on the cloth bag.

key: Describing a cricket match at differen
name: ch01_cricket_zoom_levels
alt: A cricket match seen at four zoom levels: one ball, one over, one innings, and a one-line match report.
scene: A layered illustration built like four nested picture frames, each one zooming out from the one before, arranged left to right and growing in size. SMALLEST frame on the left: a tight close-up of a single red cricket ball leaving a bowler's hand, a tiny rating star beside it. NEXT frame: a row of six balls in a line on the pitch, the bowler at the top of his run-up, a little score card showing one over and one rating badge. THIRD frame: a whole stadium seen from above with the field placed, a scoreboard showing a full innings total, one bigger rating badge. LARGEST frame on the right: an older sports journalist in a half-sleeve shirt at a press box desk with a notepad, writing a single line of summary, the whole match reduced to one sentence-shaped strip of paper, one final badge. Thin zoom lines connect the corners of each frame to the next, like a camera pulling back. Bright stadium daylight, energetic mood. Labels: "TOKEN" under the ball, "SENTENCE" under the innings, "DOCUMENT" under the report.

key: Before attention: a railway announcer he
name: ch01_announcer_note_attention

scene: A split-panel illustration of the same railway station announcement cabin, divided by a thin vertical line. The announcer is a man in his 40s with a neat moustache, white shirt and a lanyard, seated at an old microphone with a big station clock on the wall behind. LEFT panel: he listens to a long message through headphones with eyes squeezed shut, cheeks puffed, trying to hold it all in one breath; a speech bubble coming from his microphone shows jumbled, broken letters and a train icon in the wrong order, and puzzled passengers below on the platform look at each other. RIGHT panel: the same man, now calm, has a written note sheet clipped in front of him; a glowing highlight sits on one line of the note while he speaks, and a dotted arrow runs from that highlighted line to his microphone, showing he glances at the relevant line for each phrase. His speech bubble is clear and tidy. A small inset at the bottom of the right panel shows his finger still moving down the note one line at a time. Station lighting, busy platform mood. Behind her rises an enormous stack of completed worksheets, taller than her, showing she has done a huge number of them. RIGHT panel: the same view today in full colour, the same town is now a modest cluster in the foreground, while beyond it on the horizon a vast megacity of glass towers, flyovers and metro lines stretches to the edges; a young woman in a kurta and jeans stands where the official stood, holding a phone, and the old signboard has been repainted to read "TIER-3 TOWN". key: A driving test track: the same cones, th

alt: An old government form clerk accepts only plain letters, stamping anything in another script or any symbol as unknown.
scene: An old government office with wooden counters, steel almirahs and files tied with red tape. Behind the counter sits a stern clerk in his 50s with thick glasses and a sleeveless sweater, holding a big rubber stamp. In front of him, a queue of people hand in forms. A young man's form has words written in mixed small and capital letters; the clerk is rewriting them all in small letters with a pencil. An elderly woman's form has a line in a non-Latin script and a little music-note doodle, and a bird character drawn in another script; the clerk is stamping right over those parts with a red stamp that leaves a blank grey box, and the original symbols are fading away like smoke. A pile of finished forms beside him shows grey stamped boxes on many pages. The elderly woman looks confused, holding her spectacles. A small sign hanging above the counter shows only the lowercase alphabet in a neat row. Dim tube-light, bureaucratic and slightly comic mood. Labels: "UNK" on the grey stamped boxes, "LOWERCASE ONLY" on the hanging sign.

key: A courier company that has no pin-code e
name: ch02_courier_coordinates
alt: A courier clerk, unable to find a village pin code, writes long coordinates digit by digit on the parcel label instead.
scene: A small courier office counter with shelves of parcels, a weighing scale and a big map of India on the wall dotted with pins. A young courier clerk in a uniform polo shirt and cap stands at the counter with a parcel in front of him, a marker pen in hand. On his computer screen a search box shows a village name and a red message box with a crossed-out pin, meaning no pin code found. Instead of refusing, he is writing on the parcel's label a long string of separate digit boxes that runs across the whole label and spills onto a second sticker, each digit in its own little box. A small inset bubble in the corner shows the parcel later arriving at a tiny village hut among fields, where a smiling elderly farmer receives it. Beside the counter, a rival clerk in the background has stamped a different parcel with a big red reject stamp, hinting at the other approach. Afternoon daylight through a window, practical and resourceful mood. Labels: "BYTE FALLBACK" above the long label, "MORE TOKENS" under the second sticker.

key: A stenographer in court who only write
name: ch02_stenographer_no_indents
alt: A court stenographer types only the words of speech, ignoring indentation, and is lost when handed a code printout with indents.
scene: A split-panel illustration of a small Indian courtroom with wooden benches and a ceiling fan, divided by a thin vertical line, the same stenographer in both halves: a woman in her 40s in a crisp saree with her hair in a bun, seated at a stenotype machine. LEFT panel: a lawyer in a black coat and white bands speaks, and her paper tape flows out as one neat continuous block of text lines, with a green tick floating above. RIGHT panel: a young programmer in a hoodie hands her a printout of code with lines indented in clear steps like a staircase, highlighted with coloured bars at different depths. She types it, but her output tape is flattened into one even block with every line starting at the same edge, the staircase steps gone; she looks puzzled, and a red cross floats above. A dotted arrow shows the indent steps from the printout falling off the edge of the desk into a small waste basket. Formal courtroom lighting, wry mood. Labels: "SPEECH" above the left panel, "CODE" above the right panel, "INDENTS LOST" over the waste basket.

key: Filling a crossword clue when you alread
name: ch02_crossword_fill_middle
alt: A person fills the middle of a crossword using letters already present at both ends, like a code editor filling the gap at the cursor.
scene: A close view over the shoulder of a retired gentleman in a sweater vest and reading glasses, sitting at a balcony table with a morning newspaper folded to the crossword and a cup of filter coffee. In the grid, one long row has its first few letter squares and its last few letter squares already filled in, with an empty gap in between; his pencil hovers over the gap. Two glowing arrows point into the gap, one from the filled letters on the left and one from the filled letters on the right, showing that both ends shape the answer. Floating beside the newspaper is a matching inset showing a laptop code editor with a few lines at the top, a few lines at the bottom including the short words "return result", and a blinking cursor in an empty middle line, with the same two arrows pointing into it. A small flexible ruler beside the gap stretches like elastic, hinting the length of the middle is not fixed. Soft morning sunlight, quiet and thoughtful mood. Labels: "PREFIX" above the left letters, "SUFFIX" above the right letters, "MIDDLE" in the gap.

key: Teaching a child arithmetic with a calcu
name: ch02_calculator_digit_buttons
alt: A child struggles with a calculator that has odd whole-number buttons, while another child happily uses a calculator with only digit buttons.
scene: A split-panel scene at two school desks, divided by a thin vertical line. LEFT panel: a girl of about 9 in a school uniform with a red ribbon stares at a strange oversized calculator whose buttons are a messy mix of sizes and labels: some large buttons carry whole numbers like "870" and "71", while others carry single digits; she pokes at it uncertainly, and a thought bubble shows a confused tangle of arrows between the big button and a pair of small ones, unsure how they relate. RIGHT panel: a boy of about 9 in the same uniform uses a plain calculator with only the ten digit buttons in a neat grid; above it his number is built from single digits in a row, each digit sitting in a clearly marked column for hundreds, tens and ones, and he smiles confidently. A small strip of paper coming out of his calculator is noticeably longer, hinting that numbers now take more pieces. Bright classroom window light, playful mood. Labels: "MIXED CHUNKS" above the left panel, "DIGITS ONLY" above the right panel.

key: notebook with special stamps: one fo
name: ch02_law_clerk_stamps
alt: A law clerk marks the start and end of each case citation and her own working with three different stamps.
scene: A cluttered law chamber with tall shelves of thick case-law volumes, a ceiling fan and a desk lamp. At the desk sits a young law clerk in her late 20s in a white shirt and black blazer, hair in a ponytail, working through a long typed document. Beside her lies a wooden stamp tray holding three rubber stamps in three colours, each with a distinct shape on its face: a green opening bracket, a green closing bracket and a blue pencil symbol. On the document, a quoted case citation is clearly framed: a green opening stamp just before it and a matching green closing stamp just after it, while a paragraph of her own notes is boxed with the blue pencil stamp at its start. A magnifying-glass inset zooms in on one framed citation to show the two brackets sitting exactly at its edges. In the background, a senior advocate in a black gown flips through another stamped document and nods, finding the citation instantly. Warm lamp light, meticulous mood. Labels: "CITATION" above the green stamps, "WORKING" above the blue stamp, "SPECIAL TOKENS" on the stamp tray.

key: The same Hindi film released with eigh
name: ch02_subtitle_teams
alt: One film plays in a cinema while several subtitle versions underneath it each lose or keep different parts of the dialogue.
scene: A small cinema hall seen from the back rows, a large screen showing one colourful film scene: a couple singing on a hillside with musical notes floating around them and a train passing below. Under the screen, instead of one subtitle line, there is a stack of five subtitle strips, one above another, each held up by a different small team of subtitle writers standing in front of the screen. The first strip has the song notes replaced with grey blank boxes; the second strip has everything squashed into one line with no breaks; the third writes the train number spelled out in long words; the fourth keeps every pause as little dots; the fifth looks neat and complete. In the audience seats, five small groups of viewers each wear different coloured badges matching one strip and react differently: one group puzzled, one laughing, one moved. A dotted arrow from the projector to each strip shows the same film feeding all of them. Dim cinema glow with a bright screen, curious mood. Labels: "SAME TEXT" above the screen, "TOKENIZERS" beside the stack of subtitle strips.

key: Designing a keyboard for a language. Met
name: ch02_three_keyboards
alt: One keyboard factory produces three different keyboards for a programmer, a general typist and a Hindi typist.
scene: A bright factory floor seen from a slight high angle, with a single assembly line coming out of a big machine at the back marked with a gear icon. At the end of the line the conveyor splits into three branches, each delivering a different finished keyboard to a different user standing at a table. LEFT: a young programmer in a hoodie and headphones receives a keyboard where curly and square bracket keys and a wide Tab key are enlarged and highlighted. MIDDLE: an office typist, a middle-aged man in a formal shirt, receives a standard keyboard with an extra rupee key and Ctrl highlighted. RIGHT: a schoolteacher in a cotton saree receives a keyboard whose keys show Devanagari matras and letters, highlighted in saffron. Above the machine, three dials on a control panel show a layout dial, a key-count dial and a user dial, each set differently for each branch. Cheerful industrial lighting, orderly mood. Labels: "METHOD" on the layout dial, "PARAMETERS" on the key-count dial, "DOMAIN" on the user dial.

key: A token ID is like an Aadhaar number: un
name: ch02_id_number_vs_profile
alt: ID cards with numbers far apart point to profile sheets that are almost identical, showing closeness lives in the profile, not the number.
scene: A clean office desk seen from above, laid out like an explanatory board. On the left side, two plastic national ID cards lie face up, each with a generic face photo and a long unrelated number, the first card's number starting with 1 and the second with 9, with a ruler laid between them showing they are very far apart. Each card has a thin coloured thread running to the right side of the desk, where two detailed paper profile sheets are pinned side by side. The sheets show small icons in rows: a city skyline, a language speech bubble, an age bracket, and hobby icons such as a cricket bat and a book. The two profiles are almost the same, icon for icon, and they are pinned so close together that their edges overlap, with a small heart-shaped clip joining them. A third ID card with a number very close to the first sits at the top, but its thread leads to a very different profile sheet pinned far away at the edge of the desk, showing that a close number means nothing. Neutral daylight, tidy explanatory mood. Labels: "TOKEN ID" under the cards, "EMBEDDING" above the profile sheets.

key: catalogue number and the shelf it points
name: ch02_catalogue_shelf
alt: A librarian looks up a catalogue number that points to one shelf slot holding everything known about a word; a different catalogue points to the wrong shelves.
scene: A tall old library with wooden shelves numbered along their edges, a rolling ladder and a high window. In the foreground left, a librarian in her 50s in a handloom saree and spectacles on a chain flips through a long wooden card-catalogue drawer and pulls out one index card showing the number "278". A dotted arrow runs from her card across the room to shelf slot number 278, which glows softly; inside that slot sits a thick, overstuffed folder spilling notes, small sketches and sticky tabs, everything the library knows about one word. Beside the main catalogue drawer, a second catalogue drawer of a different colour has been placed by a careless young assistant; from it, a dashed red arrow points to the wrong shelf slot, where an unrelated folder sits, and a red cross floats over that path. On the shelf slot, a pencil is visibly rewriting notes inside the folder, hinting that the shelf contents change during training. Warm dusty sunlight through the window, scholarly mood. Labels: "TOKENIZER" on the catalogue drawer, "EMBEDDING MATRIX" along the shelves.

key: one-line rating card after a whole meal:
name: ch02_review_card
alt: A food reviewer condenses a whole meal into one rating card, which is filed among thousands of similar cards for quick comparison.
scene: A split-depth restaurant scene. LEFT: a food reviewer in his 30s with a goatee, a kurta and a small notebook, sits at a table that holds the remains of a whole meal: a biryani handi, a raita bowl, two kebab plates and a dessert cup, with a wall clock behind him showing a long wait. Several thin dotted lines rise from every dish and converge into a single small card in his hand, as if the whole meal is being squeezed into it. The card shows three tiny icons in a row (a biryani pot with stars, a slow snail, a thumbs up) and nothing else. RIGHT: a tall wooden cabinet of narrow drawers stands behind him, one drawer pulled open to show thousands of identical small cards lined up; a clerk in an apron slides the new card in next to two cards with very similar icons, showing it can be compared quickly with the rest. A magnifying glass in the clerk's other hand hovers over the matching cards. Warm restaurant light, satisfied mood. Labels: "TEXT EMBEDDING" on the small card, "COMPARE" above the open drawer.

key: A wedding DJ in Punjab notices that when
name: ch02_wedding_dj_requests
alt: A wedding DJ notices which songs keep getting requested together and groups them, without ever looking at the music itself.
scene: A lively outdoor wedding sangeet at night, strings of marigold and fairy lights overhead, guests in colourful turbans and lehengas dancing on a wooden floor. At the right side, a DJ in his late 20s with a beard, a black shirt and headphones around his neck stands at a mixing desk. He holds a stack of song request slips handed to him by guests, and instead of looking at sound waves or lyrics he is pinning the slips onto a corkboard beside him in little clusters. Each slip shows only a simple music-note icon with a different colour, and slips that guests requested one after another are joined by short strings, so the board shows a few tight bunches of strings. A thought bubble above his head shows a tiny map with these bunches as close neighbourhoods. An uncle in a pink turban hands him a new slip, and a dotted arrow shows it about to be pinned next to its usual companions. In one corner of the board a brand-new slip hangs alone with no strings, hinting at the cold start. Festive warm light, joyful energetic mood. Labels: "PLAYED TOGETHER" above the corkboard, "EMBEDDINGS" in the thought bubble.

key: Loading the tokenizer and the model is l
name: ch03_cook_own_cups
alt: A restaurant hires a cook who arrives with his own set of measuring cups, and the order counter handles everything from order to plate.
scene: A small restaurant seen as a cut-away, with the dining area on the left and the kitchen on the right. In the kitchen, a newly hired cook in his 30s in a white chef's coat and a cap stands at the stove, and hanging from his belt is a ring of his own colour-coded measuring cups, each numbered; a matching set of cups is tied to him with a ribbon, showing they come as a pair. On the counter next to him, a different set of cups from another kitchen has been set down by mistake, and a small red cross with a spilled, lumpy dish beside it shows what happens when the wrong cups are used. On the left, at the order counter, a cashier in a uniform takes a slip from a customer and passes it through a hatch; a smooth curved arrow runs from the order slip, through the hatch, past the cook's stove, and back out as a finished plate of food in the customer's hands, so the counter handles the whole round trip. Warm restaurant lighting, busy but organised mood. Labels: "MODEL" above the cook, "TOKENIZER" beside his measuring cups, "PIPELINE" along the curved arrow.

key: Ordering at a chai stall where the owner
name: ch03_chai_greedy_vs_sampling
alt: Two versions of a chai seller: one always pours masala chai, the other rolls a weighted dice to choose between masala, ginger and elaichi.
scene: A split-panel illustration of the same roadside chai stall, divided by a thin vertical line, the same regular customer in both halves: an office-goer in his 30s in a formal shirt with a laptop bag. Above the stall in both panels hangs a small board with three tea glasses of different sizes showing how often each is ordered: a big masala chai glass, a medium ginger chai glass and a small elaichi chai glass. LEFT panel: the chai seller, a cheerful man in a vest and a towel on his shoulder, pours masala chai without even looking up; a row of identical masala glasses lined up on the counter for each day of the week shows the same drink every day. RIGHT panel: the same seller holds a large wooden dice whose faces are painted unevenly, most faces showing masala, a couple showing ginger, one showing elaichi; he tosses it with a grin, and the row of glasses on the counter for the week now mixes mostly masala with a ginger and an elaichi in between. The customer looks pleasantly surprised. Morning street light, light-hearted mood. Labels: "GREEDY" above the left panel, "SAMPLING" above the right panel.

key: A row of cricket fielders passing inform
name: ch03_fielders_lanes
alt: Fielders stand in parallel lanes, each working at once and glancing at fielders before them, and only the last one throws to the keeper.
scene: A wide, high-angle view of a cricket practice ground painted with straight parallel lanes running from top to bottom, like a running track turned sideways. In each lane stands one fielder in whites with a number on his back, from 1 on the left to 6 on the right, all busy at the same time: one catching, one stretching, one taking notes on a small pad. The ground is divided horizontally by several white chalk lines; at each line every fielder turns his head to glance only at the fielders to his left, shown by thin dotted sight lines that point leftward and never rightward. At the far right end of the bottom row, the last fielder winds up and throws the ball in a long arc to a wicketkeeper crouched behind the stumps, with gloves raised. Each chalk line is marked by a small cone. A coach on the boundary in a tracksuit holds a stopwatch, watching all six lanes move together in step. Bright afternoon sun, energetic and orderly mood. Labels: "BLOCK" beside one chalk line, "LM HEAD" above the wicketkeeper.

key: A file moving through a government offic
name: ch03_office_desks_blocks
alt: A file passes along a row of identical desks; at each desk the clerk first reads related files on the table, then consults a rulebook, then passes it on.
scene: A long, straight corridor in a government office, seen from a slightly raised angle, with a row of identical wooden desks running from the left into the distance on the right. A single cardboard file with a red tape ribbon travels along, carried from desk to desk by a peon in a khaki uniform. At each desk sits a clerk, all in similar white shirts and spectacles but with slightly different faces. At every desk the same two-step routine is visible: first, the clerk spreads the incoming file next to several other related files on the table, and thin lines connect the file to the others as he reads across them; second, he opens a thick rulebook at his elbow and writes a note on the file. The file grows a little thicker with sticky notes at each desk as it moves along. At the far end, the finished file is placed in an out-tray. Above the corridor, dusty ceiling fans turn. Muted afternoon office light, methodical mood. Labels: "ATTENTION" above the table of related files at the first desk, "FEEDFORWARD" above the rulebook at the first desk, "BLOCKS" above the row of desks.

key: A seasoned Mumbai dabbawala does
name: ch03_dabbawala_routes
alt: A dabbawala delivers tiffins from memory and guesses the floor of a new building from the pattern of nearby buildings.
scene: A busy Mumbai street scene in late morning, with a suburban train passing on an overpass in the background. In the foreground, a seasoned dabbawala in his 50s in a white kurta-pyjama and a white Gandhi cap walks with a long wooden crate of steel tiffin boxes balanced on his head, each tiffin marked with small coloured painted symbols. He does not look at any paper or phone; instead, a large faint thought bubble above his head shows a glowing web of routes, stations and buildings, all in his memory. To the right stands a brand-new glass building he has never visited, and he is pointing at it with a confident smile; dotted lines run from two familiar older buildings on either side of it to the new one, showing he infers its delivery pattern from its neighbours. In a small inset at the corner, the same dabbawala confidently hands a tiffin to the wrong person, who looks surprised, hinting at a confident wrong guess. Bright humid sunlight, bustling mood. Labels: "IN HIS HEAD" in the thought bubble, "INTERPOLATION" beside the new building.

key: Three friends proofread your resume at o
name: ch03_three_proofreaders
alt: Three friends read the same resume at once, each checking a different thing, and their notes are merged into one corrected copy.
scene: A cosy hostel room with a study table and a pinboard, seen at eye level. On the table lies one printed resume, and three friends crowd around it at the same moment, each holding a different coloured pen and wearing a different expression. LEFT: a young woman with braids and a red pen underlines grammar mistakes, with tiny red squiggles visible. MIDDLE: a young man with glasses and a green pen draws arrows between dates on the page, checking that the years line up, a small calendar sticky note stuck on his finger, his brow furrowed in concentration. RIGHT: a young man in a hoodie holds a printed job advertisement next to the resume with a blue pen, drawing matching ticks between the two. Below the table, three dotted arrows, one red, one green and one blue, flow down into a single neat final resume held by the owner, a nervous but relieved young woman in a formal shirt standing in the foreground. Warm desk-lamp light, collaborative mood. Labels: "HEADS" above the three friends, "COMBINED" beside the final resume.

key: A matrimonial site. Each profile has a k
name: ch03_matrimonial_qkv
alt: Profile cards each show a front advert and a back of real qualities; a seeker compares her wish list with every advert and gathers a blend of the best matches.
scene: A colourful scene set inside a giant open laptop, as if the matrimonial website has become a hall. On the left stands a young woman in her late 20s in a kurta, holding a wish-list card with three simple icons on it (a book, a cooking pot, a mountain). In front of her, a row of five large standing profile cards fan out, each card with a generic face silhouette. The front of each card shows a short set of advertised icons, and a small flap on the back of each card, lifted open, reveals what the person actually brings (a small bag of qualities with icons like a helping hand, a smile, a toolbox). Thin beams of light run from her wish-list to the front of each card, glowing bright for close matches and faint for poor ones. From the back flaps, little streams of the quality icons flow into a single bowl she holds in her other hand, thick streams from the bright matches and thin trickles from the faint ones. Soft pastel lighting, hopeful mood. Labels: "QUERY" on her wish-list, "KEYS" above the fronts of the cards, "VALUES" beside the bowl.

key: Making a masala blend: 50% from the ca
name: ch03_masala_blend_jars
alt: A cook spoons spices from several jars in very unequal amounts into one grinder, producing a blend that tastes mostly of the biggest shares.
scene: A close, top-down view of a kitchen counter with a row of round steel spice jars from a masala dabba laid out in a semicircle, each jar with a little hand-written paper tag showing a word in place of a spice name: a cat drawing, the word "the", and a few other small word tags. Above the jars, a woman's hands, with green glass bangles, spoon spices into a small electric grinder jar in the centre. Large spoonfuls come from the cat jar, a medium spoonful from the "the" jar, and tiny pinches from the rest, with each spoon carrying a small percentage flag: 50%, 35% and a few small ones. Coloured streams of powder from each jar pour into the grinder, and the resulting blend in a small bowl beside it is clearly mostly the colour of the cat jar's spice, with a slight tint of the second. A magnifying-glass inset shows the powder as a grid of tiny numbers, hinting it is really a vector. Warm afternoon kitchen light, homely mood. Labels: "WEIGHTS" above the spoon flags, "OUTPUT" beside the blended bowl.

key: The Indian Railways coach design has sta
name: ch03_coach_upgrade
alt: An older passenger coach and a newer one stand side by side, the same overall shape but with upgraded bogies, brakes and couplers highlighted.
scene: A railway yard scene at platform level, two passenger coaches parked side by side on parallel tracks under a corrugated shed. LEFT: an older blue coach with its classic window pattern and slightly worn paint. RIGHT: a newer red and silver coach with the same general shape, the same long body and rows of windows, clearly recognisable as the same kind of train. Three magnifying-glass bubbles hover over the newer coach's lower parts: one zooms into its redesigned wheel bogie, one into its modern disc brake, and one into its shiny new coupler at the end, each glowing softly. Matching faded bubbles over the older coach show the older versions of the same parts. A railway engineer in a navy uniform and a hard hat walks between the coaches holding a clipboard, comparing the two with a satisfied look. In the far background, a modern train pulls out of the station. Morning light through the shed roof, steady and practical mood. Labels: "2017" above the older coach, "2024" above the newer coach, "BETTER PARTS" beside the three bubbles.

key: Reading a long cricket commentary: ful
name: ch03_commentator_attention_spans
alt: Three commentators look back over a match in different ways: one re-reads every ball, one looks only at the last few overs, one also checks every fifth over.
scene: A wide commentary box high above a cricket stadium, with a big glass window showing the green field below. A long scroll of paper representing the whole commentary so far stretches across the back wall like a timeline, divided into numbered overs. Three commentators in blazers and headsets sit side by side at the desk. LEFT: an older commentator with grey hair turns all the way round and runs a finger along the entire scroll from the very first over, looking a little tired; long sight lines fan out to every over. MIDDLE: a young commentator glances only at the last few overs just behind him, with a short bright highlight on that end of the scroll. RIGHT: a woman commentator glances at the last few overs and also at small flagged markers placed at every fifth over along the scroll, her sight lines jumping in a regular pattern. A digital clock on the wall and a scoreboard outside show the match is well into the innings. Bright stadium light, lively mood. Labels: "FULL" above the left commentator, "LOCAL" above the middle commentator, "STRIDED" above the right commentator.

key: An exam hall. Multi-head: every studen
name: ch03_exam_hall_shared_books
alt: Three exam halls compared: every student with their own textbook, one textbook for the whole hall, and one textbook per bench.
scene: A three-panel horizontal strip showing three identical exam halls from the front, rows of wooden benches with two students per bench, all in school uniforms, each student holding a pencil and a small question slip of their own. LEFT panel: every student has their own thick textbook open on the desk, the hall crowded with books, a heavy pile of spare books at the door. MIDDLE panel: a single large textbook sits on a stand at the front of the hall, and all the students crane their necks towards it, with long sight lines stretching from every bench to that one book. RIGHT panel: each bench of two shares one textbook placed between them, the two students leaning in together, a moderate number of books visible. In each panel, a supervisor in a saree walks the aisle carrying the books; she is struggling under a tall stack on the left, carrying almost nothing in the middle and a light armful on the right, hinting at how much memory each layout moves. Bright classroom light, focused mood. Labels: "MULTI-HEAD" above the left panel, "MULTI-QUERY" above the middle panel, "GROUPED-QUERY" above the right panel.

key: A residual connection is the original ph
name: ch03_stapled_original
alt: A draft passes from desk to desk with the original photocopy always stapled underneath, and each clerk cleans their glasses before reading.
scene: A row of three office desks seen from the side in a calm government office, each with a clerk in a white shirt. A single document travels from left to right across the desks. At every desk, the clerk first wipes their spectacles with a small handkerchief, shown with a tiny sparkle on the lenses, before reading. Then they write fresh notes in a different ink colour on a new top sheet: blue at the first desk, green at the second, orange at the third. Underneath the growing stack of notes, the same original photocopy page, slightly yellow and marked with a small paper clip and staple, stays attached the whole way, clearly visible peeking out from beneath every version. A dotted line runs along the bottom from the original page at the first desk to the stack at the last desk, unbroken, showing the original is never lost. At the end, a manager holds up the final bundle where all the notes and the original line up together. Soft natural window light, tidy and reassuring mood. Labels: "RESIDUAL" beside the stapled original, "PRE-NORM" beside the glasses being wiped.

key: Two clock hands. Each tok
name: ch03_clock_hands_rope
alt: Two pairs of clock hands at different times show the same angle between them, with extra small dials spinning at different speeds.
scene: A clean, symmetric illustration of two old round wall clocks hung side by side on a plain wooden wall in a railway station waiting room. Each clock face has two hands of the same length, one painted red and one painted blue, representing two tokens. On the left clock, the hands point roughly to 9 and a little after; on the right clock, the same pair of hands points roughly to 3 and a little after, but in both clocks the angle between the red and blue hands is exactly the same, and a small curved arc with the same shading marks that angle on both faces. Below each big clock hang several small dials in a row, like extra gauges, whose single hands visibly spin at different speeds, with motion streaks long on the fastest and short on the slowest. A curious passenger in a sweater and a muffler, sitting on a bench below with a suitcase, looks up and compares the two arcs with a finger held in the air. Calm afternoon light through tall windows, quiet mood. Labels: "SAME ANGLE" between the two clocks, "MANY SPEEDS" under the row of small dials.

key: The same engine design ending up in cars
name: ch03_engine_many_machines
alt: One engine design sits at the centre with arrows to a car, a boat, a generator and a robot, each using it with a different input attachment.
scene: A bright workshop scene with a polished engine block standing on a turntable in the centre, its pistons and gears visible through a cut-away window. Four arrows lead out from it in four directions to four very different machines, each fitted with the same engine. TOP LEFT: a small family car on a road, with a funnel at the front taking in a stream of word cards. TOP RIGHT: a fishing boat on blue water, its funnel taking in square picture tiles cut from a photograph. BOTTOM LEFT: a diesel generator at a construction site, its funnel taking in small sensor readings drawn as little dials. BOTTOM RIGHT: a friendly robot arm on a factory table, its funnel taking in ticking clock icons representing time steps. Each funnel is shaped differently, showing that each domain needs its own way of chopping input before the same engine works on it. A mechanic in blue overalls stands near the turntable, wiping his hands with satisfaction. Even workshop lighting, optimistic mood. Labels: "ATTENTION" on the central engine, "TOKENS" beside one of the funnels.

key: A board exam. The train split is the tex
name: ch04_board_exam_splits
alt: A student studies from a textbook, takes a mock exam to adjust, and the final paper stays sealed in an envelope until the end.
scene: A three-part scene arranged left to right in a student's world, the same girl of about 16 in a school uniform with a long plait in each part. LEFT: at a cluttered study desk at home under a table lamp, she works through a thick textbook and a stack of practice question sheets, highlighters scattered around. MIDDLE: in a classroom, she sits a pre-board mock exam; afterwards she looks at the marked paper and a curved dotted arrow loops from the mock paper back to her study desk on the left, showing she changes how she studies because of it. RIGHT: in front of an exam hall door stands a stern invigilator in his 50s holding a large brown envelope sealed with red wax and string, the final question paper, untouched; a padlock icon floats beside it. In a small corner inset, a mischievous boy peeks through a gap in the envelope, hinting at what happens if the test leaks into study. Soft daylight across all three parts, earnest mood. Labels: "TRAIN" above the study desk, "VALIDATION" above the mock exam, "TEST" above the sealed envelope.

key: A task-specific model is a ready-made th
name: ch04_thermometer_vs_blood_test
alt: A thermometer gives a simple fever reading, while a blood-test machine prints a long sheet of numbers that a doctor learns to read.
scene: A split-panel clinic scene divided by a thin vertical line, the same patient in both halves: a young man in a striped shirt sitting on an examination stool. LEFT panel: a nurse in a white uniform holds a digital thermometer to his forehead; the small screen shows a single simple icon of a flame, meaning fever, and nothing else; the thermometer has a small factory seal sticker on it. RIGHT panel: a large sealed blood-test machine with a factory seal sticker stands beside him, and a long paper printout curls out of it, covered in rows and rows of tiny numbers. A doctor in her 40s with a stethoscope around her neck holds the printout and runs a pen along it; a thought bubble above her shows a small balance scale weighing many tiny numbers at once, with a fever flame icon on one side, showing she is learning which pattern of numbers means fever. A notebook beside her lists her learned weights as tiny marks. Clean clinic light, professional and calm mood. Labels: "TASK-SPECIFIC" above the left panel, "EMBEDDINGS" above the right panel, "FROZEN" on the factory seal stickers.

key: Hiring a cook for a busy dhaba. The top-
name: ch04_fast_dhaba_cook
alt: A prize-winning chef plates one fancy dish slowly while a long queue waits, beside a quick dhaba cook serving everyone in minutes.
scene: A split-panel scene of a busy highway dhaba at lunch, divided by a thin vertical line, with trucks parked in the background. LEFT panel: a celebrity-style chef in a tall white hat and a medal ribbon around his neck, a framed trophy on the wall behind him, carefully arranges one elaborate plate with tweezers; a clock on the wall above him shows twenty minutes have passed, and a long queue of hungry truck drivers and families snakes out of the door, some sitting on their luggage, looking annoyed. RIGHT panel: a quick, cheerful cook in a vest and towel turban works three tawas at once, sliding rotis and ladling dal; the clock above him shows two minutes, and a short, happy queue moves along as plates go out steadily. Between the panels at the top, a small podium shows the fancy chef on the top step and the quick cook on the second step. A small inset at the bottom shows a stopwatch and a measuring tape on the dhaba's own counter, hinting you should time it in your own kitchen. Hot midday light, lively mood. Labels: "TOP OF LEADERBOARD" above the left panel, "FAST ENOUGH" above the right panel.

key: New at a railway parcel office, with n
name: ch04_parcel_signboards
alt: A new parcel-office worker sorts parcels by comparing each one to the wording on two signboards, without having seen any examples.
scene: A railway parcel office on a platform, with wooden shelves, a weighing scale and parcels wrapped in jute and tape. A new worker, a young man in his early 20s in a uniform shirt slightly too big for him, stands on his first day between two large painted signboards hanging over two bays. The left signboard shows a wine-glass icon and a cracked-glass symbol, and the right signboard shows a heavy kettlebell icon. He holds up a parcel and looks from the parcel to each signboard in turn, with two dotted lines comparing it to both, the line to the matching board glowing brighter. Behind him, a trolley of parcels is already partly sorted into the two bays. On the far right, a supervisor on a ladder is repainting one signboard with a longer, clearer picture (a glass, a laptop and a fragile sticker together), and the worker's sorting into that bay becomes noticeably neater. In a small inset at the bottom corner, a parcel with a cheerful smiley sticker but a broken item inside is placed in the wrong bay, hinting at misleading wording. Platform daylight, earnest mood. Labels: "ZERO-SHOT" above the worker, "LABEL TEXT" beside the signboards.

key: pretraining is a fill-in-the-blanks exam
name: ch04_t5_coaching_format
alt: Students practise fill-the-gap sentences, then a coaching centre puts every subject on the same question and answer sheet format.
scene: A two-part scene joined by a big curved arrow from left to right. LEFT part: a classroom where a teenage boy in a school uniform works on a worksheet in which whole chunks of a sentence are covered by long grey tape strips, not single words; he is writing whole phrases into the gaps, a pile of finished sheets beside him. RIGHT part: a bright coaching centre with a banner of many subject icons (a globe for translation, a grammar book, a scroll for summaries), and a long row of identical answer sheets pinned on the wall, each sheet with exactly the same two boxes, one marked "Q" at the top and one marked "A" below it, filled with different subject icons. The same boy, now a little older, sits at a desk filling in yet another identical sheet, while a teacher in a cotton saree adds more subject flags to a board that is overflowing with hundreds of tiny subject icons. At the edge of the right part, a strict checker with a red pen inspects an answer sheet's format with a magnifying glass. Bright classroom light, diligent mood. Labels: "PRETRAINING" above the left part, "SAME FORMAT" above the row of sheets.

key: training is like training a new waiter
name: ch04_waiter_ranked_answers
alt: A head waiter first demonstrates what to say, then ranks a trainee waiter's three attempts from best to worst.
scene: A two-part restaurant scene with white tablecloths and brass lamps, separated by a thin vertical line. LEFT part: an experienced head waiter in his 50s with a neat moustache, black waistcoat and bow tie, stands beside a trainee waiter in his early 20s in a similar uniform, and demonstrates how to describe a dish to a seated couple, with the trainee copying his gestures and writing in a notebook. RIGHT part: the trainee now presents three short speech bubbles, each describing the same plate of biryani differently, labelled with large letters A, B and C. The head waiter holds up three ranking cards beside them: a gold first-place card on C, a silver card on B and a red cross on A. A small cloud kitchen hatch appears in the background of the right part, with a closed shutter, a payment slot and a hanging sign showing a small clock, hinting that at rush hour it asks you to wait. Warm dining-room light, instructive mood. Labels: "INSTRUCTION DATA" above the left part, "PREFERENCE DATA" above the ranking cards.

key: 44,949 abstracts is like the whole readi
name: ch05_abstracts_on_table
alt: A mountain of unlabelled papers dumped on a long table, with a machine sorting them into labelled bundles.
scene: A wide university seminar room with tall windows and old ceiling fans. A long wooden table runs across the middle, completely buried under a mountain of loose printed papers and stapled abstracts that spill onto the floor, with no folders, tabs or labels anywhere. Three tired research students stand around it: a young woman in a kurta holding her head in her hands, a young man in a hoodie peering at a single sheet with a magnifying glass, and another student staring at the pile with wide eyes. At the right end of the table sits a friendly boxy machine with a conveyor belt, pulling papers from the pile and dropping them into neat bundles tied with string on a trolley; each bundle has a small icon tag: a microphone, a medical cross, a smiling and frowning face pair, a globe. A wall calendar behind them shows many years of pages torn off and piled in a corner, hinting at decades of research. Afternoon light streaming in, overwhelmed but hopeful mood. Labels: "NO LABELS" above the paper mountain, "CLUSTERS" above the bundles on the trolley.

key: Sorting wedding guests into tables: (1
name: ch05_wedding_guest_tables
alt: A wedding planner writes long profile cards for guests, condenses them to a few traits, then seats similar guests together and leaves one stranger at the side.
scene: A three-stage scene in a decorated wedding hall with marigold garlands and round tables, read left to right. LEFT: a wedding planner in her 30s in a silk saree and a headset sits at a desk writing long, detailed profile cards for each guest, a tall pile of filled cards beside her, each crammed with tiny icons. MIDDLE: she runs the cards through a small paper-trimming machine that cuts each card down to a short strip with just three bold icons: a side-of-family flag, an age-group icon, and a language speech bubble. RIGHT: the hall itself, where guests are seated at round tables in matching groups, an aunties table in bright sarees, a college-friends table in trendy kurtas, an elders table with walking sticks, each table sharing the same three icons on a small table card. One lone guest in a plain shirt stands at the side near the pillar with a cold drink, not seated at any table, looking content. No number of tables is fixed in advance; a spare unused table stands folded against the wall. Warm festive lighting, joyful mood. Labels: "EMBED" above the left desk, "REDUCE" above the trimming machine, "CLUSTER" above the seated tables.

key: An embedding is like a 384-question surv
name: ch05_survey_forms
alt: Many documents each fill in a very long survey; two surveys with nearly identical ticks are clipped together as similar.
scene: A bright, tidy office scene with a long survey form shown as the centrepiece. In the foreground, several little document characters, little rolled scrolls and folded papers with tiny arms and legs, sit at school desks each filling in a very long form that unrolls to the floor like a receipt, every line with a row of small tick boxes, the ticks scattered at different heights like a fingerprint. On the right, a clerk in a sleeveless sweater holds two of the completed forms up against a light box, one over the other; their tick patterns line up almost perfectly, and he clips them together with a bright paper clip, smiling. Beside him, a third form held against the light shows a completely different pattern and is set aside in another tray. The questions on the forms are deliberately unreadable, shown as faint grey squiggles, hinting that no single question has a clear human meaning. A wall poster shows a number badge reading "384". Even office light, orderly mood. Labels: "SIMILAR" above the clipped pair, "EMBEDDING" along the long unrolled form.

key: A shadow puppet. Your 3-D hand becomes a
name: ch05_shadow_puppet
alt: A hand makes a deer shadow on a wall when held at the right angle and a blob at the wrong angle, with a crumpled paper being unfolded beside it.
scene: A dark room at night lit by a single lamp on a low stool, a plain white wall at the back, seen from slightly behind two children. LEFT half: a girl of about 10 in a night suit holds her hand up in the lamp's beam at the right angle, fingers spread like antlers, and the wall shows a crisp shadow of a deer with clear antlers; her younger brother claps. RIGHT half: the same hand turned at a wrong angle produces a shapeless dark blob on the wall, and the brother tilts his head, puzzled, unable to tell what animal it is. A thin dotted arrow runs from the three-dimensional hand to the flat wall, showing depth being lost. In the bottom right corner, an inset shows a grandfather in a shawl gently unfolding a crumpled sheet of paper flat on a table, its creases still faintly visible, hinting that bending and unfolding can keep more of the shape than a straight shadow. Warm lamp glow against a dark room, cosy and curious mood. Labels: "384D" beside the hand, "5D" on the wall shadow, "UMAP" beside the unfolded paper inset.

key: A topic as keywords is like the Swiggy s
name: ch05_restaurant_tags_vs_signboard
alt: A restaurant listing shows only three keyword tags, while next to it a painter writes a proper name on a signboard.
scene: A street scene split into two linked parts. LEFT: a large phone screen held by a hungry young man in a hoodie shows a food app listing card for a restaurant, with a photo of a steaming biryani handi and three small tag chips underneath, one of which reads "biryani" and the others showing tiny kebab and bowl icons; above his head a thought bubble shows him guessing, with a question mark and a map of the Deccan region. A fourth chip at the end is a dull grey blank chip, hinting at junk words that sometimes sneak into tags. RIGHT: the actual restaurant across the road, a narrow building with green shutters, where a signboard painter in a paint-stained kurta stands on a bamboo ladder painting a large name board above the entrance with bold strokes; the board has a decorative border and a painted handi, and the man in the hoodie is now looking up at it with recognition. A dotted arrow runs from the tag chips on the phone to the painted signboard, showing the step from keywords to a proper label. Golden evening light, friendly mood. Labels: "KEYWORDS" above the tag chips, "LABEL" beside the painted signboard.

key: Each cluster is a WhatsApp group; c-TF i
name: ch05_group_chat_words
alt: Several group chats float side by side; a greeting appears in all of them, while one distinctive phrase appears often in only one group.
scene: A clean layout of five tall phone-screen panels standing side by side like tall windows, each showing a different family or friends group chat, with message bubbles in different colours and a tiny group icon at the top: a family house, a cricket bat, a cooking pot, an office briefcase, a school bag. In every one of the five panels, the same sunflower greeting sticker with a sunrise appears several times, and a grey dotted line links these identical stickers across all five panels, showing that they appear everywhere. In the cricket-bat panel only, many bubbles contain the same small icon of a captain's armband with a cricket ball and a trophy, repeated again and again, and these are highlighted with a bright glowing outline. A magnifying glass held by an off-screen hand hovers over the cricket panel, focusing on the armband icons, while the sunflower stickers in the other panels are faded and greyed out. Soft screen glow on a dark background, playful analytical mood. Labels: "EVERYWHERE" beside the faded sunflower stickers, "C-TF-IDF" above the magnifying glass.

key: One Activa scooter, many uses: deliver
name: ch05_scooter_attachments
alt: The same scooter model is shown three times with different attachments: a delivery box, a child seat and a vegetable rack.
scene: A sunny neighbourhood street lined with small shops and a neem tree, with three identical grey scooters of the same plain model parked side by side at the kerb, each clearly the same body and engine. LEFT scooter: a large insulated delivery box is strapped to the back, and a young delivery rider in a red jacket checks his phone beside it. MIDDLE scooter: a small padded child seat is fixed in the front, and a mother in a salwar kameez helps a small boy in a school uniform with a backpack climb in. RIGHT scooter: a wooden rack is fitted behind the seat, piled with baskets of tomatoes, spinach and cauliflower, and a vegetable seller in a vest and a towel on his head is calling out to customers. A thin dotted outline highlights the matching engine area on all three scooters, showing the core is identical. In the background, a fourth scooter rides away with both a box and a child seat at once, hinting that attachments can be combined. Bright morning light, everyday cheerful mood. Labels: "SAME ENGINE" above the three engine outlines, "MODULES" beneath the attachments.

key: An IRCTC Tatkal queue: a fast clerk firs
name: ch05_shortlist_senior_clerk
alt: A fast junior clerk prints a quick shortlist of trains, and a senior clerk carefully reorders just that shortlist for the passenger.
scene: A railway booking office early in the morning, a long line of passengers holding bags at a counter with two windows side by side. LEFT window: a fast young clerk in his 20s with rolled sleeves rapidly runs a finger down a giant fold-out timetable covering the whole wall behind him, thousands of rows, and prints a short list of thirty trains on a narrow paper strip, with motion lines showing his speed. A dotted arrow carries that strip to the RIGHT window, where a calm senior clerk in her 50s in a cotton saree and spectacles on a chain reads only the short strip, not the wall, and rearranges the slips on her desk into a new order, putting the best one at the top with a gold star, while chatting with the passenger, an elderly man in a dhoti with a walking stick who nods. The rest of the giant timetable is greyed out behind her, untouched. In a corner of her desk, a small empty slip with a question mark shows she cannot add a train that is not on the strip. Soft dawn light, orderly mood. Labels: "SHORTLIST" above the paper strip, "RERANKER" above the senior clerk.

key: Choosing hashtags for a set of travel re
name: ch05_reel_hashtags
alt: A traveller watches three of her best mountain reels, forms a vibe, and keeps the hashtags that match it while discarding the dull ones.
scene: A cosy homestay room with a wooden window looking out on snowy mountains and pine trees. A young travel creator in her mid 20s, in a woollen cap and a puffer jacket, sits cross-legged on the bed holding a phone. Floating in front of her are three glowing phone screens showing three of her best reels: a mountain road with prayer flags, a river valley, and a steaming cup of tea on a snowy balcony. Thin coloured streams rise from the three reels and merge into a single soft glowing cloud above her head, her overall vibe, with tiny mountain and pine icons inside. Below, a row of floating hashtag chips is lined up; a chip with a mountain icon glows green and slides into her post, while a dull grey chip reading "#the" turns red and falls away. At the far end of the row, a small niche chip with a tiny gear icon floats in grey, slightly ignored, hinting that the vibe may miss rare expert tags. Crisp mountain daylight, dreamy relaxed mood. Labels: "AVERAGE VIBE" beside the glowing cloud, "KEEP" above the green chip.

key: Picking a cricket XI. The best 11 batsme
name: ch05_cricket_xi_mmr
alt: A selector picks a cricket team where each new pick is good but different, instead of eleven similar batters.
scene: A split-panel cricket selection scene, divided by a thin vertical line, both halves in a selection room with a big whiteboard. LEFT panel: a team photo of eleven nearly identical batters in whites, all holding bats and wearing the same helmet, posing awkwardly with no keeper gloves or ball in sight; a large red cross floats above them, and the scoreboard in the corner shows a tiny bowling column. RIGHT panel: a sharp chief selector in his 50s in a blazer stands at the whiteboard and pins photos one at a time; the first pick is the star batter with a gold star, and each later pick is clearly different: a wicketkeeper in gloves, a spinner holding the ball with a twisted wrist, a tall fast bowler mid-stride, an all-rounder. Thin dotted arrows from each newly pinned photo point back to the photos already on the board with small not-equal signs, showing each pick is checked for being different. The final balanced team poses together at the bottom with a green tick. Bright committee-room light, decisive mood. Labels: "TOP 11 ONLY" above the left panel, "GOOD AND DIFFERENT" above the right panel.

key: Learning to drive: you start on an Alto,
name: ch06_small_car_first
alt: A learner confidently drives a small hatchback, while another learner struggles moving from a big bus with a helper down to a tiny car.
scene: A split-panel scene on a driving-practice ground with cones and a painted parking grid, divided by a thin vertical line. LEFT panel: a young woman in her early 20s in a kurta and sunglasses drives a small white hatchback around the cones with relaxed confidence; behind her in the distance a large SUV is parked with its door open, and a dotted arrow from the hatchback to the SUV shows the easy next step. RIGHT panel: a young man in a checked shirt first sits high in the driver's seat of a big 40-seater bus, with a helper conductor standing beside him pointing and guiding, power-steering icon glowing on the dashboard; a dotted arrow then leads down to the same young man squeezed into a tiny hatchback with no helper, gripping the wheel nervously, sweat drops on his forehead, knocking over a cone. A small coin purse and a little clock icon float near the hatchback on the left side, hinting that the small car is cheaper and quicker to run. Bright afternoon sun, encouraging but humorous mood. Labels: "START SMALL" above the left panel, "JARRING" above the right panel.

key: A railway reservation form. You do
name: ch06_reservation_form_template
alt: A clerk reads a neatly filled form with boxes instantly, while a messy free-text application slows him and leads to small mistakes.
scene: A reservation office counter seen from the passenger side, a steel grille and a stamp pad on the counter. A clerk in his 40s with a moustache and a navy sweater over his shirt sits behind the window. LEFT side of the counter: a neatly filled printed form with clear labelled boxes in a fixed layout, a top box with a small person icon, a middle box with a speech bubble icon, and thick lines separating each box like end markers; the clerk's eyes run straight down it with a smooth dotted path and he is already stamping it with a green tick. RIGHT side of the counter: a second passenger hands in a page of messy handwritten paragraphs on plain paper with no boxes; the clerk is still reading it, a faint frown, and his output ticket coming out of the printer has one tiny wrong detail circled faintly in grey that nobody notices, showing quality drops quietly. A wall poster behind him shows the exact form layout with the box order highlighted. Fluorescent office light, orderly mood. Labels: "CHAT TEMPLATE" above the neat form, "USER" on the top box, "ASSISTANT" on the middle box.

key: Ordering at a kirana shop with a long sh
name: ch06_shelf_topk_topp
alt: A long kirana shelf of brands from best-seller to rarely bought, with one shopper limited to the first five and another to the brands covering most sales.
scene: A very long kirana shop shelf seen from the front, stretching from the left edge of the picture far into the distance on the right, packed with biscuit packets of different plain unbranded designs. Under each packet a small bar shows how often it sells: very tall bars at the left, shrinking quickly into a long tail of tiny bars that fades into the far right. Two shoppers stand in front. FIRST shopper, a schoolboy with a backpack, has a wooden frame held up that covers exactly the first five packets, and he picks only among those. SECOND shopper, a woman in her 30s in a salwar kameez, has a stretchy rope that she has pulled along the shelf until the tall bars inside it add up to a filled gauge marked 90%; her rope covers just three packets here because the first brand's bar is enormous. Above both shoppers, a small thermometer-like dial labelled with a brave face and a calm face shows how adventurous each is when choosing within their range. Warm shop light, playful mood. Labels: "TOP-K" above the schoolboy's frame, "TOP-P" above the woman's rope, "LONG TAIL" over the faded far end.

key: Briefing a new intern. Your first brie
name: ch06_intern_brief_iterations
alt: A manager rewrites a brief three times, adding one instruction each round, while the intern's output gets closer to what was wanted.
scene: A three-panel horizontal strip in a small startup office with whiteboards and plants, the same two people in each panel: a manager in her 30s in a blazer and a fresh intern in his early 20s with a lanyard. PANEL ONE: the manager hands over a sticky note with just one short scribble; the intern returns a tall messy stack of pages, and the manager frowns slightly. PANEL TWO: she hands over the same note with a second line added and a small one-page icon drawn on it; the intern returns a single page, closer but with a plain layout, and she tilts her head. PANEL THREE: the note now has a third line with a small company template icon; the intern returns a neat single page on the company template, and she smiles and gives a thumbs up. A dotted arrow loops from each result back to the next note, showing the cycle of try, look, refine. In the bottom corner of panel three, the sticky note is pinned to a board labelled for keeping, hinting the instructions must be saved and reused because the intern forgets. Bright office light, hopeful mood. Labels: "TRY", "LOOK" and "REFINE" above the three panels.

key: A long WhatsApp voice note from your mot
name: ch06_voice_note_middle
alt: A long voice note plays as a waveform; the start and end messages are remembered clearly while the middle part fades away.
scene: A cosy evening scene of a young man in his late 20s in office clothes walking home through a market street, holding a phone to his ear with earphones in. Floating above him in a long horizontal strip is a giant audio waveform of a long voice note from his mother, shown as a ribbon of wavy bars running from left to right. At the left end of the ribbon, a bright speech-bubble icon shows a phone with a callback arrow; at the right end, another bright bubble shows a milk packet. Both of these glow and are connected by dotted lines into a thought bubble above the man's head, where the phone and milk icons are clearly visible. In the middle of the ribbon, a third bubble with an electricity meter and a bill sits dim and grey, partly dissolving into floating dust, and it never reaches his thought bubble. In a corner inset, his mother at home in a cotton saree records the voice note with the phone held close to her mouth. Warm market lights, gentle humorous mood. Labels: "START" above the left end, "END" above the right end, "LOST IN THE MIDDLE" under the dim middle bubble.

key: Teaching a new cook at a dhaba how you w
name: ch06_dal_bowl_example
alt: A dhaba owner places one finished bowl of dal in front of a new cook and says like this, and the cook copies it exactly.
scene: A small dhaba kitchen with a row of large dal pots, a gas stove and steel tumblers on a shelf. On the left, the owner, a broad-shouldered man in his 50s with a turban and a kurta, has stopped explaining; behind him, a faded speech bubble full of crossed-out wavy description lines shows that talking did not work. Instead he sets down one finished bowl of yellow dal on the steel counter, with a neat swirl of tadka on top and a sprig of coriander, pointing at it firmly. On the right, a new young cook in a vest and a cap leans in and studies the bowl closely, then ladles his own dal into a second bowl beside it that looks almost identical in colour, thickness and swirl; a thin dotted line connects the two bowls showing the copy. In a small inset in the top corner, the next morning, the same young cook stands puzzled before an empty counter where the sample bowl is gone, and the owner has to put down a fresh sample bowl again. Warm kitchen light and rising steam, practical mood. Labels: "EXAMPLE" beside the owner's bowl, "FEW-SHOT" above the matching bowls.

key: First the date, then the venue (needs th
name: ch06_wedding_planner_chain
alt: A wedding planner completes steps in order, date then venue then caterer, each step handed the decisions from the previous ones.
scene: A wedding planner's office with a big corkboard wall and fabric samples. Across the wall runs a chain of four large cards pinned left to right, joined by thick arrows, with the planner, a brisk woman in her 40s in a printed saree and a headset, moving along the chain with a marker. FIRST card: a calendar page with one date circled. SECOND card: a photo of a banquet hall with garlands, with a small copy of the circled date clipped to its corner. THIRD card: a caterer's menu with steaming dishes, with small copies of the date, the hall photo and a guest-count tally clipped on. FOURTH card: a printed invitation with a mandap drawing, carrying all the earlier clips. A young couple sits on a sofa in the foreground watching, relieved. In a small inset at the bottom, the first card has a tiny mistake circled in red, and a red dotted line shows that mistake travelling along every arrow into all the later cards, with a small checkpoint gate drawn in grey between cards as a suggestion. Warm office light, organised mood. Labels: "STEP 1" on the first card, "CHAIN" above the arrows.

key: A school maths exam where
name: ch06_show_your_working
alt: Two students solve the same exam question: one writes each step and catches a mistake, the other writes only a wrong final number.
scene: A split-panel exam hall scene at two neighbouring wooden desks, divided by a thin vertical line. LEFT panel: a focused girl of about 14 with a ponytail and a school tie writes on her answer sheet line by line; her sheet shows a tidy column of short steps and one step has been crossed out and rewritten correctly, with a small lightbulb above her pencil where she caught the error, and a teacher's green tick and extra marks awarded in the margin. RIGHT panel: a boy of the same age with messy hair has written only one large number in a box with nothing above it, and the teacher's red cross sits beside it; he scratches his head in confusion. A dotted arrow in the left panel runs from each written step down to the next, showing how each line helps the one after it. On the blackboard behind them, a teacher's chalk note shows a small pencil icon with a staircase, meaning write the steps. Bright classroom light, focused mood. Labels: "STEP BY STEP" above the left panel, "JUST ANSWER" above the right panel.

key: Planning a route home in Bengaluru traff
name: ch06_traffic_junction_pruning
alt: A rider at each junction considers a few roads, drops the red jammed ones and only explores the green ones further.
scene: A high-angle bird's-eye view of a dense city road network at evening rush hour, roads branching like a tree from a starting point at the bottom to a small house at the top. At the bottom, a young office-goer in a helmet on a scooter waits at the first junction, a phone mounted on his handlebar showing a map. At each junction, two or three roads branch out; roads are coloured by traffic, some glowing green, some red and packed with tiny cars and autos. Every red road is marked with a big X a short distance from the junction and fades out, never explored further. Only green roads continue upward to the next junction, where they branch again and are pruned again. A faint ghostly trail shows one fully-driven alternative route reaching the house, marked as the slower brute-force way. Small floating thought bubbles at each junction show the rider's quick ratings as one, two or three stars, one of them with a faint question mark, hinting the ratings are only guesses. Golden-hour light with glowing tail lights, busy but calm mood. Labels: "PRUNE" beside an X on a red road, "TREE OF THOUGHT" above the network.

key: A UPI payment screen. Before money moves
name: ch06_payment_checks
alt: A payment screen runs several checks before money moves, like a backend validating untrusted output.
scene: A close view over the shoulder of a young woman in her 20s at a vegetable cart, holding a phone at chest height to pay; the vegetable seller with a weighing scale waits in the background. Her phone screen is shown large and clear: before the payment goes through, three checkpoint gates are lined up in sequence on the screen, like small toll barriers.
